cards: Card identifier hashes the canonical UTF-8 LF payload without card_id; the card manifest hashes complete card-file bytes.
package_artifacts: Raw downloaded wheel bytes with x1-pinned SHA-256 for direct packages and recorded closure hashes.
promotion_receipts: Raw local and promoted checkout bytes. Generated YAML metadata may retain CRLF outside Git; canonical validation checks raw receipt parity and LF-normalized Git parity separately.
self_exclusions: Stage manifests exclude their own manifest and staged-review receipt. The final stage also declares owner-manifest and content-seal as terminal derivatives. The owner manifest excludes itself and content-seal; the external canonical binds the exact final commit.
stage_and_owner_manifests: Exact Git blob bytes after the declared LF text filter.
